name.description: Name of the site, in the header and in the title of every page.

logo.description: Path of the logo shown before the name in the header, relative to this file; an SVG is inlined so that it can follow the current colour.

favicon.description: Path of the favicon, relative to this file; copied under assets/.

font.description: Font families by role. A project ships the font files itself, under assets, with @font-face rules in its stylesheet: the site never loads a font from a third-party host.

display.description: Family of the headings; the platform fonts when absent.

ui.description: Family of the interface text; the platform fonts when absent.

mono.description: Family of code and identifiers; the platform fonts when absent.

radius.description: Corner radius of surfaces and controls, in pixels.

light.description: Palette of the light mode, six required #RRGGBB colours and three optional ones. Text must reach a 4.5:1 contrast over bg, surface and soft, headings 3:1; the build reports the pairs below.

surface.description: Background of the header, the cards and the panels.

accent.description: Accent of links, focus rings and the current position; never a status, a decoration or the only carrier of an information.

label.description: The lightest text: the labels of the panels, counts and notes; muted when absent. Must reach 4.5:1 over bg, surface and soft.

soft.description: Background of the fields, the chips and the current entry of the tree, between bg and surface; bg when absent.

highlight.description: Background of a marked passage, the searched word in a result for instance, read in ink; border when absent.

dark.description: Palette of the dark mode, the same colours as light, with the same contrast requirements: a second palette, never an inversion of the first.

surface.description: Background of the header, the cards and the panels.

accent.description: Accent of links, focus rings and the current position; never a status, a decoration or the only carrier of an information.

label.description: The lightest text: the labels of the panels, counts and notes; muted when absent. Must reach 4.5:1 over bg, surface and soft.

soft.description: Background of the fields, the chips and the current entry of the tree, between bg and surface; bg when absent.

highlight.description: Background of a marked passage, the searched word in a result for instance, read in ink; border when absent.

default_mode.description: Palette the site starts with; the reader's own choice, remembered by the mode switch, wins.

text.description: A paragraph shown in the footer.

links.description: Links shown in the footer, in order.

credit.description: Whether the footer credits the tool with a discreet link to its repository; nothing else in the interface names it.

stylesheet.description: Path of a stylesheet loaded after the tool's own, in the project cascade layer, relative to this file.

assets.description: Path of a folder copied as-is under assets/ of the site (fonts, icons), relative to this file.

labels.description: Interface labels to override, by language of a shipped catalogue then by message identifier. A value is an ICU MessageFormat message that must use exactly the variables of the source message; the build refuses an unknown identifier, a syntax error or a different set of variables.
